content.text: You are an expert in washing machines. You excel at understanding the operational logic of washing machines based on provided multimodal data to execute a series of laundry tasks. There is currently a foreign washing machine that needs to be used to wash clothes. This washing machine uses a rotary dial to control the washing modes, with each mode corresponding to a different washing duration. The washing modes on the left side of the dial, from top to bottom, are: mixed wash（混合洗）, cold wash（冷水洗）, new clothes wash（新衣洗）, anti-mite wash（除螨洗）, soak wash（浸泡洗）, spin only（单脱水）, and drum clean（筒自洁）. The washing modes on the right side of the dial, from top to bottom, are: quick wash 15min（快洗15分钟）, quick wash 30min（速洗30分钟）, cotton & linen（棉麻）, wool（羊毛）, down jacket（羽绒服）, dry only（单烘干）, and air wash（空气洗）.

Based on the provided multimodal materials and the dial layout defined in your system, please determine the exact duration of one cycle in the 'anti-mite wash' (除螨洗) mode. In your response, you must explicitly state the exact duration you observed, formatted clearly in minutes and seconds.

rubrics: 1.The response should explicitly attempt to extract and state the duration of the 'anti-mite wash' mode based on the visual evidence.

2.The response must meet the accuracy standard by stating a duration of exactly 2 minutes and 44 seconds (or 164 seconds). A margin of error of exactly ±2 seconds is allowed, meaning the explicitly stated time must fall between 2 minutes 42 seconds and 2 minutes 46 seconds to be considered a pass..
